in_hebrew.name: Leland
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Land or territory
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Leland הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The Old English name Leland is derived from the Old English words leah and land, meaning 'land' or 'territory'. The name was commonly given to those who lived in rural areas or owned land.

in_greek.name: Leland
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Land or territory
in_greek.long_meaning: Leland είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. The Old English name Leland is derived from the Old English words leah and land, meaning 'land' or 'territory'. The name was commonly given to those who lived in rural areas or owned land.

in_latin.name: Lelandus
in_latin.meaning: nomen Anglicum, significationem non habet in lingua Latina
in_latin.long_meaning: Lelandus, nomen Anglicum, a topographia Angliae derivatum, in lingua Latina primo usum habet in seculo XVIII, significatio non habet, sed in lingua Anglicana significat 'locus in terra culti' vel 'vallis culta'.
